summary: Frontend-only regression + new entry flow test for LOKAGER public demo. Verified '/' shows ceremony (launch-button + launch-title), tapping launch begins DHMS countdown at 00d/00h/00m/59-60s (initial render captured 59s within ~1s of click, indicating COUNTDOWN_MS=60000 counting elapsed real time) and decrements accurately (54s after +5s wait). Waited full ~60s and celebration/reveal appeared with eyebrow 'CONGRATULATIONS!', 'LOKAGER', 'is now live', tagline 'WHERE PROPERTY MEETS TRUST.', and enter-lokager-button. Auto-enter navigates to /home after ~5s (URL === '/home'). Browser Back after auto-enter does NOT return user to running countdown (navigate uses replace). Demo banner correctly hidden during '/' idle, '/launch' idle, countdown and reveal phases; visible on /home and all sub-routes (/buy /rent /new-projects /commercial /land /mortgage /saved /compare) each returning 200 with single H1 and robots 'noindex,nofollow,noarchive,nosnippet' and canonical NOT pointing to lokager.com. /home survives reload. No horizontal overflow at 1920/1440/1366/430/390. /launch opens fresh as ceremony-phase-idle. Immediate ENTER LOKAGER button click during reveal navigated to /home (screenshot confirms homepage + demo banner render). No app-origin console/page errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Countdown timer initial text at ~1s post-click shows '00:00:00:59' rather than '00:00:01:00' due to elapsed-time model (ok per spec: starts at 60s and decrements). If founder wants the very first visible frame to read '01 MINUTES / 00 SECONDS', consider rendering ceil(remaining/1000) or delaying first tick. Non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Entry flow validated at preview URL. Full 60s wait was performed twice (auto-enter and immediate-enter paths). Countdown text format is exact: 'DD DAYS : HH HOURS : MM MINUTES : SS SECONDS'. Header logo navigates via SiteHeader to /home (does not restart ceremony). Regression baseline (iter_12) preserved.
